title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
Can YOU find the hidden diamond? Pick your box and see if you're right! Like and subscribe for Level 2 tomorrow! 💎🎉

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #DiamondChallenge #FunForKids #PickOne #Reveal

scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a giant diamond!
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the golden box? Choose now!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue gold gift boxes row

scenes.narration: Three... two... one... let's find out!
The red box opens and... it's a rubber chicken! Not the diamond!
The blue box opens and… whoa, it's a pile of socks! So close!
The golden box opens and… YES! There it is! The giant sparkling diamond!
Did you pick gold? Level 2 is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
